# eLife

> eLife is a peer-reviewed, open-access journal pioneering reform in scientific publishing through transparent peer review, preprint assessment, and community-driven research dissemination.

eLife publishes high-quality research across life sciences and biomedicine while advancing open science principles and diversity in academia. The organization combines traditional peer review with innovative models like reviewed preprints and public assessments to improve scientific communication and reproducibility.

## Key Topics

- open-access publishing
- peer-review reform
- scientific publishing
- research articles
- reviewed preprints

## Research Discovery & Browsing

- [Latest research | eLife](https://elifesciences.org): eLife homepage showcasing latest research highlights and open science publications
- [Browse the latest research | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/browse): Browse and filter eLife research articles by category and peer-review quality
- [Research Articles | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/articles/research-article): eLife peer-reviewed research articles across life sciences and biomedicine
- [Reviewed Preprints | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/reviewed-preprints): eLife reviewed preprints with assessments, public reviews, and author responses
- [Structural Biology and Molecular Biophysics | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/subjects/structural-biology-molecular-biophysics): eLife research category for structural biology and molecular biophysics articles

## Publishing & Submission

- [Submit your research | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/submit-your-research): Manuscript submission guidelines and peer review process for eLife authors
- [Why publish with eLife? | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/about/why-publish-with-elife): Benefits of publishing with eLife and author testimonials on peer-review model
- [About eLife | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/about): eLife mission and organization overview on peer-review reform and open science

## Magazine & Feature Content

- [Magazine | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/magazine): eLife magazine featuring science articles, podcasts, and research digests
- [Feature Articles | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/articles/feature): eLife feature articles on research culture, science policy, and career development
- [Editorials | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/articles/editorial): eLife editorial collection on publishing reform, peer review, and reproducibility
- [Scientific Publishing: Rethinking how research is reviewed and published | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/articles/110392): eLife article on peer-review reform and innovative journal publication models
- [Equity, Diversity and Inclusion: Four women whose pioneering contributions to science have been largely overlooked | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/articles/110644): Feature on overlooked women scientists in developmental biology and history

## Community & Diversity

- [Community | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/community): eLife community programs promoting open science, diversity, and early-career researchers

## Press & Media

- [For the press | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/for-the-press): eLife press releases, media coverage, and press inquiry guidelines
- [eLife receives Wellcome boost to build open publishing ecosystem | For the press | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/for-the-press/60edaa10/elife-receives-wellcome-boost-to-build-open-publishing-ecosystem): Press release on Wellcome funding for eLife open publishing ecosystem development

## Optional: Research Examples

- [Toward neuroanatomical and cognitive foundations of macaque social tolerance grades | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/articles/106424): Research article on macaque neurobiology and cognitive evolution by eLife
- [Agent-based modeling reveals how bats navigate dense group emergences | eLife](https://elifesciences.org/articles/105571): Research article on bat echolocation and collective behavior navigation
- [Human adherent cortical organoids in a multiwell format](https://elifesciences.org/reviewed-preprints/98340): Reviewed preprint on iPSC-derived cortical organoids for drug discovery
